name: FounderGate RunGrid Autonomy Controller
purpose: Drive FounderGate work gate-to-gate with ONE founder action, eliminating repeated manual prompt relays, while preserving every hard safety boundary and the freeze -> Checker -> Gate Advisor discipline.

terminal0.authority: integration sheriff; owns reconciliation, freezing, packaging; does NOT certify its own work

builders.isolation: one run-scoped worktree/branch each, disjoint owned paths

narrow_sensitive_writer.note: at most ONE narrow-sensitive writer active, and only under separate explicit authorization; default 0

gate_advisor.mode: read-only, separate, runs after Checker, emits only allowed verdicts

invariants: no two lanes own the same path
wide-safe lanes only unless a narrow-sensitive writer is separately authorized (default none)
no post-freeze/post-review mutation without returning to correction + fresh Checker & Advisor
Terminal-0 does not certify its own work
all material state written to disk (no terminal-only evidence)
final ZIP only at true gates
hard_prohibitions: no GitHub-visible mutation except explicitly-authorized non-main evidence branch pushes (secret-scanned)

founder_interaction_policy.routine_internal_gates: NO founder prompt relay — Terminal-0 advances automatically Builder->freeze->Checker->Advisor->reconcile->package
true_founder_gates_only: mark a PR ready-for-review or merge
any irreversible or outward-facing action beyond an authorized non-main evidence push
evidence contradiction / unsafe mutation / ambiguous state
founder_interaction_policy.at_true_gate: STOP, package a sealed ZIP, surface a single plain-English decision; do not proceed

authority_basis: chains on the sealed L2/L3/L4/PR201 packages (all Checker CLEAN + Advisor READY_WITH_LIMITS).
